feedfromchests_subtitle: Uses your inventory first, then chests within {0} m. The station's own limits still apply.
feedfromchests_nothing_to_add: Nothing to add: no item this takes in your inventory or nearby chests
feedfromchests_output_chests: What it makes goes into chests
feedfromchests_output_ground: What it makes drops on the ground
feedfromchests_takeoff_on: Done food comes off by itself
feedfromchests_takeoff_off: Done food stays on (and can burn)
feedfromchests_couldnt_add: Couldn't add {0} (full, or not accepted right now)
feedfromchests_nothing_by_hand: Nothing to add by hand right now: none of what this takes is in your inventory or the nearby chests.
feedfromchests_tip_menu: Tip: turn on AlwaysOpenMenu in the FeedFromChests config to get the menu (Fill, Add 1) every time
feedfromchests_auto_on_help: Keeps this stocked from chests within {0} m, by itself. It only uses the items switched on below, plain ones first.
feedfromchests_auto_off_help: Turn on to keep this stocked from nearby chests without pressing anything. You choose which items it may use.
feedfromchests_taps_help: When the mead is ready it comes out by itself (and with auto-load on, the next base goes straight in).
feedfromchests_takeoff_help: The moment something is done it comes off, so it never burns: into a chest (below), or it slides off the side of the spit towards you.
feedfromchests_takeoff_config_off: Switched off for every station in the config (Cooking, TakeOffCooked).
feedfromchests_output_mead_help: Goes to a chest assigned to that mead or to Potions (K), or one that already holds it. With none, it drops as usual.
feedfromchests_output_food_help: Goes to the chests assigned to that food or to Food (the chest assign menu, K), nearest first. With none, it slides off the spit.
feedfromchests_output_help: Goes to the chests assigned to that item (the chest assign menu, K), nearest first. With none assigned it drops on the ground as usual.
feedfromchests_fuel_off_warn: {0} is off, so this will run out of fuel and stop.
feedfromchests_make_each_until: Make each thing it makes until the chests hold
feedfromchests_kiln_target_help: It stops loading once your chests (and what is already in the kiln) add up to this much {0}.
feedfromchests_kiln_target_help_each: It stops loading once your chests (and what is already in the kiln) add up to this much of each thing it makes.
feedfromchests_leave: Always leave this much {0} in the chests
feedfromchests_leave_each_wood: Always leave this much of each wood in the chests
feedfromchests_kiln_reserve_help: Wood it will never use, for building. 0: it may use all of it (up to the target).
feedfromchests_smelter_fuel_help: It smelts all the ore it is given; this only keeps some {0} back for other uses.
feedfromchests_leave_each_crop: Always leave this much of each crop in the chests
feedfromchests_mill_reserve_help: Kept back for planting, so you never grind your last seeds.
feedfromchests_use_all: 0 = it may use all of it.
feedfromchests_oven_target: Bake each kind until the chests hold
feedfromchests_oven_target_help: Counted for each kind of bread or pie on its own. 0 = no limit.
feedfromchests_spit_target: Cook each kind until the chests hold
feedfromchests_spit_target_help: Counted for each cooked food on its own. 0 = cook everything.
feedfromchests_spit_reserve: Always leave this much of each raw meat
feedfromchests_spit_reserve_help: Kept raw, for taming. 0 = cook all of it.
feedfromchests_ferment_target: Brew each mead until the chests hold
feedfromchests_ferment_target_help: Counted for each mead on its own, so one you have plenty of is skipped. 0 = no limit.
feedfromchests_cook_hover_takeoff: Done food comes off by itself: {0}
feedfromchests_needs_roof: needs a roof and walls round it to ferment
feedfromchests_ferment_hover: Auto-load from chests: {0}, taps itself when ready: {1}
feedfromchests_hive_biome: Bees don't live in this biome
feedfromchests_hive_covered_hint: (needs under {0}%: move it out from under roofs and trees)
feedfromchests_hive_full: Full: it stops making honey until it is emptied
feedfromchests_hive_next: Next honey in {0} min (one every {1} min, up to {2})
feedfromchests_hive_collect: Honey goes into a chest assigned to it or to Food (K), or one that already has honey
feedfromchests_refuels: Refuels itself with {0} from chests within {1} m
